evals.prompt: Analyze this frontend project and generate a DESIGN.md from its source code. Use the global CSS, theme tokens, shared components, and dark mode definitions. Do not invent a spacing scale when the code does not define one.
evals.expected_output: A canonical DESIGN.md generated in project mode, preserving explicit source values and omitting unsupported tokens.

evals.prompt: Generate a DESIGN.md from https://example.com. Inspect the public page and its CSS, preserve exact observed values, include the source website line, and do not turn visual guesses into precise tokens.
evals.expected_output: A canonical DESIGN.md generated in URL mode with source attribution and evidence-backed sections only.

evals.prompt: Create a DESIGN.md from the project in the current workspace and also compare it with https://example.com as secondary evidence. Use the codebase as the primary source and call out conflicts instead of silently replacing code-defined tokens.
evals.expected_output: A project-primary canonical DESIGN.md; the URL is treated only as corroborating evidence.
